notes.title: Introvert Quest Patch 1.2. is Live
notes.notes:
The long awaited Introvert Quest Patch 1.2. is live!!!

It took us a long while but we finally managed to release this awesome patch that will fix all game breaking bugs, fix most minor bugs and fully unlock the new game plus true ending of the game.

First of all we want to thank all the fans that sent us feedback about the bugs, their experiences with the game and just in general words of support. We would like to take the time to explain what happened to the development process of Introvert Quest and our other games in this announcement.
A couple of years ago we started out as a 4 man team with the goal to develop fun games, along the years we had our ups and downs and needless to say some things happened that have severely hindered our capability to create patches and new games.
Our small group grew even smaller and a lot of our data (patch 1.2 for introvert quest and our full game Last Sin were lost due to a critical hardware failure caused by natural disasters) - Yeah what are the odds... We were very depressed to have lost all our development and we took quite some while to get over it. In a sense we where like Bryce, depressed and in a very bad place. But time and friends help heal all wounds and we started to get our s*** back together.
We started to work on the Last Sin and the Introvert Quest Patch 1.2 again from scratch. It took us a couple of months to figure everything out and create something we are truly proud of. We love Introvert Quest and we wanted to offer our players the ability to finish the game the way it was meant to be. There is a story we wanted to tell and it was unfinished for a too long time. And for that we are truly sorry, this new patch is our way to apologize to all our players. 

Patch Notes:
-All game breaking bugs are fixed (Walking home with Alice bug, the medieval fare, Santa bug, new game + bug)
-Many minor bugs are fixed (sometimes after certain Digital duels Bryce would transform into his monster)
-We added many new scenes with the main cast to better flesh out each character
-We added new side quests to Sky City
-New game plus rework - now after the credits scene the players will continue to the true second part of the game containing the true end of the game 
-Balanced some fights that where too hard to defeat
-Added new enemies to the game

NOTICE for saves from version 1 and 1.1.
For all players that have a save state that they wish to continue from we will have to apologize because the patch will only work for players that start a new game. This is due to certain new variables and switches being activated in the prologue that fix many things later on. We hope that you will all give our game another try.

P.S. We are working on another patch for Introvert Quest that would only add more content and side quests as well as a complete overhaul patch for 1914: Prelude to Chaos.

Thank you very much and we wish everyone a good mental state in these trying times. 

Amaterasu Software

notes.title: Introvert Quest Patch 1.1
notes.notes:
After long delay Introvert Quest Patch 1.1 is live!

Due to personal reasons we could not work on our games for quite some time, we are very sorry about that and we would like to apologize to our fans. The work on Introvert Quest is not complete and we will be active in the forums to work out any missed bugs, but for now we have changed the following:

-New game+ with a new main story containing the true ending of the game
-Fixed many bugs (especially at the fair and the Santa alley bug)
-Added new lines of dialogue 
-Other little things

We hope that you will enjoy the game as much as we enjoyed making it.

Happy adventures,

Team Amaterasu
